q: About what share of a normal distribution lies within 2 SDs of the mean?
Heights have mean 170 and SD 10. Find the z-score of 185.
why: Divide by the SD, not the variance: z = 15/10 = 1.5.

q: Any data with a mean and an SD follow a normal distribution.
why: Myth. Incomes, waiting times and many other data are skewed. Every data set has a mean and an SD.
It's negative for values below the mean, 0 at the mean and positive above it.

q: For a standard normal Z, what is P(Z < 0)?
why: The curve is symmetric around 0, so exactly half lies below it.
